state: Client create, populated edit, update and archive cleanup

create.result: Created one synthetic client through the real production Clients form; the list returned the saved name, phone, email and New status.

open_and_populate.result: Opened the real client detail route and Edytuj modal; existing name, address, notes, source, owner and contact links were populated in the live UI.

save_update.result: Saved edited synthetic name, address, phone, email and notes through the real update mutation; the detail view returned the edited values and the old name was absent.

reload_consistency.result: After the mutation settled, the detail route read back the edited name, address, phone link and email link from the production data source.

cancel_close.result: A second edit was changed and cancelled; the dialog closed and the persisted edited name remained while the cancelled value did not appear.

archive_cleanup.result: The synthetic client was archived through the visible destructive control and native confirmation; the Clients list contained no synthetic record afterward.

browser_diagnostic_boundary.finding: The approved browser inspection API redacted or returned blank values for controlled phone/email inputs during direct value readback, although the rendered production UI and post-save detail links showed the values.
browser_diagnostic_boundary.interpretation: This was a diagnostic-layer limitation, not an application defect; no raw CDP, standalone browser, cookie/session extraction or DOM mutation was used.

root_cause.ui: Client Detail used a legacy inline editor instead of the populated canonical client form and required a shared controlled edit owner with real update/delete wiring.
root_cause.runtime: The verified Supabase user response exposes id; the shared auth context previously read only legacy user_id/sub aliases, causing authenticated activity requests to fail with AUTH_ACTOR_REQUIRED.
root_cause.guard: The A26 activities guard referenced retired split-handler and migration paths; it was reconciled to the consolidated activities handler, route and current migration.

next_action: FRT-030 acceptance recorded; continue with the active FRT-031 client New Case stage.
